app.meta_description: Static audio and transcript viewer for transcript.words.v1 meeting artifacts.
app.no_context_bundle: This build cannot assemble a context bundle.
app.insight_rename_busy: Another rename is still saving. Try again in a moment.
app.delete_confirm_body: Deleting removes the recording, transcript and tags for everyone who can see it. This cannot be undone.

meetings.said: Search meetings and what was said in them

meetings.name_date: Search meetings by name or date

insights.name_date: Search insights by name or date

both.name_date: Search meetings or insights by name or date

meeting_list.empty_body: Recordings you publish from Talk show up here.
meeting_list.no_insights_body: Pick some meetings, ask one question of them, and the answer is kept here beside them.
meeting_list.searching_said: Looking for “{query}” in what was said.
meeting_list.insights_have_no_tags: Insights carry no tags, so a tag filter hides them.

names_dates_no_match.meetings: Names and dates match no meeting, and what was said could not be searched.
names_dates_no_match.insights: Names and dates match no insight, and what was said could not be searched.
names_dates_no_match.both: Names and dates match no meeting or insight, and what was said could not be searched.

names_dates_no_match_here.meetings: Names and dates match no meeting here, and what was said could not be searched.
names_dates_no_match_here.insights: Names and dates match no insight here, and what was said could not be searched.
names_dates_no_match_here.both: Names and dates match no meeting or insight here, and what was said could not be searched.

meeting_list.no_meeting_has_tag: No meeting here has that tag.
meeting_list.no_meeting_has_tags: No meeting here has those tags.
meeting_list.no_meeting_has_tag_and_search: No meeting here has that tag and matches that search.
meeting_list.no_meeting_has_tags_and_search: No meeting here has those tags and matches that search.

no_match_in_room.meetings: No meeting in {room} matches that search.
no_match_in_room.insights: No insight in {room} matches that search.
no_match_in_room.both: No meeting or insight in {room} matches that search.

no_match_partial.meetings: No meeting matches that search — but only {searched} of {total} could be searched for what was said in them.
no_match_partial.insights: No insight matches that search — but only {searched} of {total} could be searched for what was said in them.
no_match_partial.both: No meeting or insight matches that search — but only {searched} of {total} could be searched for what was said in them.

no_match.both: No meeting or insight matches that search.

nothing_to_show.meetings: There are no meetings to show.
nothing_to_show.insights: There are no insights to show.
nothing_to_show.both: There are no meetings or insights to show.

rooms_rail.audience_lead: Nextcloud Files controls who can read each recording.
rooms_rail.audience_point_all: Each recording is shared with all of the Talk room's participants, whether they were present on the call or not.
rooms_rail.audience_point_guests: Guests without a Nextcloud account can't open it.
rooms_rail.audience_point_public: Cassini never creates a public link. In public rooms, people can reshare the file if this Nextcloud allows it.

selection_bar.what_next: Tag, download or get insights from them.

selection_bar.over_cap_other: You can work with up to {max} meetings at once. Unpick {count}.
selection_bar.dropped_one: 1 selected meeting is no longer in the archive and was removed.
selection_bar.dropped_other: {count} selected meetings are no longer in the archive and were removed.

selection.over_cap_one: You can work with up to {max} meetings at once. Unpick one.
selection.over_cap_other: You can work with up to {max} meetings at once. Unpick {count}.
selection.no_portable_audio_one: One of these predates the single-file format (marked in the list). Unpick it to prepare.
selection.no_portable_audio_other: {count} of these predate the single-file format (marked in the list). Unpick them to prepare.

room_name.title: Rename room
room_name.current_saved_review: Current saved name: {name}. Review it, then save again.
room_name.current_saved_draft_kept: Current saved name: {name}. Your draft is unchanged.
room_name.scope: This name is shared with everyone who can access this room in Cassini.
room_name.invalid_characters: Use a name without control characters.
room_name.invalid_length: Use a name between 1 and {max} characters.

connect_agent.title: Connect an agent
connect_agent.intro: Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client can read the meetings you see here. It reads as you, and it can only read: it cannot mark, rename or delete anything.
connect_agent.step_password: {title} in {link}. Revoking it disconnects the agent.
connect_agent.step_add: {title} For Claude Code, with your app password in place of {placeholder}:
connect_agent.more: Other agents and the command line

import.title: Import meetings
import.intro: Add meetings downloaded from Cassini, here or on another Nextcloud: the recording (.opus), or just its transcript (.json).
import.note: Speaker names, tags and the summary come with the file. You choose who can see each meeting before it is added.
import.not_a_meeting: Not a meeting file from Cassini, so it was skipped.
import.add_sharee_placeholder: Add a person, group or team
import.remove_title: Delete the temporary upload and remove this attempt.
import.dismiss_title: Hide this row. It stays in the server's import history.
import.settled_server_failed: Import on the server didn't finish
import.sharing_only_you_title: Only you can open this meeting.
import.sharee_search_failed: Could not search people right now.
import.not_portable: Not a portable meeting: neither an Ogg/Opus recording nor a transcription document.

tags.none_yet_create: No tags yet. Type a name to create one.
tags.confirm_none: None of your meetings use it.
tags.confirm_one: Updates one of your meetings. Meetings that are in rooms you can't access will keep the old tag.
tags.confirm_other: Updates {count} of your meetings. Meetings that are in rooms you can't access will keep the old tag.
tags.busy: You already have a change running.
tags.change_failed: That change didn't go through. Try again.
tags.error_unresolved: Remove the marks that can't be placed first.
tags.error_busy: Tags are being changed elsewhere. Try again in a moment.

list_tags.confirm_failed_meeting: Could not confirm the tag update for “{title}”: {reason}
list_tags.confirm_failed_meetings_one: Could not confirm the tag update for 1 meeting: {reason}
list_tags.confirm_failed_meetings_other: Could not confirm the tag update for {count} meetings: {reason}
list_tags.too_many: Tag at most {max} meetings at once.

catalog.load_failed: Could not load the meeting list (HTTP {status}).

search.unreachable: Could not reach the search index.
search.rate_limited: Too many searches just now — try again in a moment.
search.not_ready: The search index is not ready yet.
search.unreadable: The search index answered something this viewer cannot read.

export_transfer.no_file: {title} has no meeting file to download.
export_transfer.download_failed: Couldn't download the meeting file for {title} ({status}).
export_transfer.too_large: The selected meeting files are too large for one download.

ui.copy_blocked: Copying is blocked here. It is selected: press ⌘C or Ctrl+C.
